TERMS.S9_INTRO: Café Lab is designed for professional use from a desktop or laptop computer. The user is responsible for using equipment that meets the minimum requirements described.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.QUESTION_1: How can I register on the platform?
FAQ.ANSWER_1: To register, click the 'Sign Up' button at the top of the page. Complete the form with your personal and business information. Once submitted, you will receive a confirmation email to activate your account.
FAQ.QUESTION_2: What features are included in my free account?
FAQ.ANSWER_2: The free account includes basic access to coffee batch recording, basic supplier management and coffee defect consultation. For advanced features like detailed analytics and custom reports, you can upgrade to a premium plan.
FAQ.QUESTION_3: How can I recover my password?
FAQ.ANSWER_3: On the login page, click 'Forgot your password?' Enter your registered email and we will send you a link to reset your password. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.
FAQ.QUESTION_4: Can I change my subscription plan at any time?
FAQ.ANSWER_4: Yes, you can upgrade or change your subscription plan at any time from your account settings. Changes will be applied immediately and billing will be prorated accordingly.
FAQ.QUESTION_5: How can I contact technical support?
FAQ.ANSWER_5: You can contact us through this form, by sending an email to contacto@cafelab.com, via WhatsApp at +51 912 345 678, or through our LinkedIn profile. Our office hours are Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
